title: The Life Changing Magic of Tidying Up
author: Marie Kondo
summary: Marie Kondo sets out her method of tidying by category, keeping only what sparks joy and giving everything else a thankful goodbye, to keep a home in order for good.
readIf: you want a clear, step-by-step plan to declutter your home.
skipIf: you dislike rigid rules or the idea of talking to your belongings.
